club.channel.rulesGate.title.zh-Hans: 俱乐部频道公约与安全守则（App Store 1.2）

club.channel.rulesGate.body.zh-Hans: 参与频道发言与治理前，请确认遵守社区安全准则：严禁发布违法违规、骚扰辱骂、欺诈广告及令人反感的内容。被举报内容将在 24 小时内由安全团队审核并处理，违规成员将被删帖并移出或封禁。
club.channel.rulesGate.body.en: Before posting or moderating, you must agree to our zero-tolerance policy against objectionable content, harassment, and spam. Reported content is reviewed within 24 hours and violators will be removed or banned.

club.channel.rulesGate.accept.zh-Hans: 我已阅读并同意频道公约

club.channel.rulesGate.acceptedBanner.zh-Hans: 已同意俱乐部频道公约与安全守则，现在可以发言与参与互动。
club.channel.rulesGate.acceptedBanner.en: Channel rules and safety guidelines accepted. You may now post and participate.

club.channel.composer.rulesLocked.zh-Hans: 请先在上方阅读并同意《俱乐部频道公约》后再发言。
club.channel.composer.rulesLocked.en: Please accept the Channel Rules & EULA above before sending messages.
